dict.string: Camera Transfer connects to your camera over its Wi-Fi network to copy photos, and runs a small FTP server so your Sony camera can send photos to this iPhone.
Camera Transfer uses Bluetooth only to switch on your Ricoh GR IV's Wi-Fi and to notice when the camera is turned on.
Camera Transfer can add transferred photos and videos to your library when you ask it to, or automatically in an auto-transfer mode. It cannot see your existing photos.
